menu.agents: Tell AI Agents About This Project…
agents.title: Tell AI agents about Allomos?
agents.body: The agents you choose open in the project folder with a request already typed in: add Allomos's instructions to AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md. Nothing is sent until you send it.
agents.how_link: opens with the request typed in
agents.how_paste: opens a terminal; the request is on the clipboard to paste
agents.claude_app_trust: The Claude app may first ask you to trust this folder: choose Trust workspace, or the session starts without the project.
agents.none: No AI agent was found on this computer.
agents.asked: Opened {agents}. Read the request there and send it.
agents.written: Added Allomos's section for AI agents to {files}.
agents.asked_convert: Opened {agent}. Read the request there and send it. Before the agent changes anything, its plan appears here for you to confirm or cancel.
confirm.from_unknown: An AI agent asks before changing this project:
confirm.cancelled: Cancelled: nothing was changed. To ask again, tell the AI agent in its window, for example "I changed my mind — please show me the plan again", or choose File → Move Tasks Into Allomos… to start again with any agent.
convert.title: Find this project's tasks and move them into Allomos?
convert.body: Choose one AI agent. It opens in the project folder with a request already typed in: look for tasks the project already keeps (a task board, card files, a to-do list). If it finds some, it asks you once, here: its whole plan to go ahead or cancel. Go ahead lets it move the tasks into this taskbag, switch AGENTS.md to Allomos, remove the old status, commit, and merge into your branch. It never pushes. Nothing is sent until you send it.
convert.none: No AI agent was found on this computer. Install Claude Code or Codex, then try again.

notice.created_here: Created an empty taskbag in .allomos/taskbag/ inside this empty folder.
notice.created_here_readme: Created an empty taskbag in .allomos/taskbag/ inside this empty folder, and README-allomos.md to say what the folder is.

pending.body: {folder} has other files but no Allomos taskbag.
pending.git: It is inside the Git repository {repo}. Your task files will be versioned by that repository; Allomos does not create a second one and does not run Git.
folder.title: Which folder holds this project?
folder.body: Allomos keeps this project's tasks in {folder}. Choose the folder with the project's code and its AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md; often it is this same folder. AI agents work there.
welcome.title: Your project's tasks, in a folder you choose.
welcome.body: Pick a folder. If it already holds a taskbag, Allomos shows its tasks grouped by area. Otherwise Allomos creates the taskbag, with a small starter project, in {dir} inside that folder: right away when the folder is empty, and after asking when it has other files, such as a code repository.

problem.open_failed: Could not open {path} in the file manager: {detail}.
